definitions.explanation: The crime of a public official or person in a position of trust accepting money or favors in exchange for improper treatment.

examples.japanese: {収賄|しゅうわい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{収賄|しゅうわい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That assembly member is suspected of taking bribes.

examples.japanese: {収賄|しゅうわい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{役人|やくにん}→役人：12611_yakunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The official who took bribes was found guilty at trial.

notes:
A legal term for the offense of accepting bribes, committed by a public official or someone in a position of trust. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to mean 'to accept a bribe.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収賄|しゅうわい}⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧: suspicion of bribe-taking
- {収賄|しゅうわい}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: a bribery case
- {収賄罪|しゅうわいざい}: the crime of accepting bribes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贈賄|ぞうわい}→贈賄：21598_zouwai⟧: bribery (the giving side) — offering the bribe, the opposite role
- ⟦{汚職|おしょく}→汚職：17399_oshoku⟧: corruption — broader misuse of public office, of which {収賄|しゅうわい} is one form
